'''Venik Rin''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] master as a [[boddah]]. Rin was once attacked by a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], which seriously mauled him, causing him to walk with a permanent limp.<ref name="LoNH" />
